name: Runtime Entry Bridge
purpose: Trace and bridge the unavoidable verified document/runtime path to bootstrap ignition without relying on guessed application lifecycle hooks.
ignition_contract: Verified loader dispatches existing igniteProofBootstrap8617 only after actual Engine visibility is observed; existing ignition promise remains idempotent.
safety: existing Memory Muster and bootstrap runner remain authoritative
release_gate: A live Engine session must be observable by the verified loader and must dispatch bootstrap ignition from that proven state.
